claims: Named vendor-boundary cases use metadata getInfo before public connect and direct boolean kill for deletion, preserving post-positive failures and existing domain/config forwarding.
Caller and returned reference guards reject routing ambiguity; method-spy identity checks do not establish returned HTTP wire identity.
limitations: Only the named local lifecycle/selected existing cases are recorded; this is not native API, full-provider, physical deletion or billing certification.
Existing installed dependencies were reused without a clean install; compatibility across declared dependency ranges is unverified.
List and unrelated getInfo/execution/egress-recovery fallbacks are outside these new lifecycle checks. Retained terminal records are not filtered into null.
An internal vendor create can accept a resource and then fail before returning an ID; these adapter checks do not recover every such hidden allocation.
Installed e2b2.30.1 can convert body code404 to typed missing before checking actual HTTP status; actual HTTP auth/error provenance is not guaranteed.

Public native connect stamps the requested ID instead of validating returned wire identity and can resume/renew. Vendor-method spies do not prove wire behavior; dynamic undici is not intercepted by a global fetch stub.
Existing ambient domain/endpoint behavior and list catchalls are unchanged; retained terminal metadata may not be connectable.
command: pnpm --filter @computesdk/lelantos --fail-if-no-match exec vitest run src/__tests__/lifecycle-contract.test.ts src/__tests__/connection-opts.test.ts src/__tests__/run-command-env.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1
mockBoundary: Real factory with public vendor-method spies and actual exported error classes; forwarding fixtures are framework-only.
scope: Historical component-input-specific local regression evidence, not all-capability, live-provider or future-tree certification.
